info.name: Cash me Up (Sebaka) - APIs for front-end
info.description:
Postman collection for the APIs the Cash me Up front-end talks to.

Folder 1 is LIVE now: Spring Boot email-code API, runs locally - see the 'How to run locally' paragraph below. The 502 test needs the SMTP sink stopped first.

How to run locally (3 terminals, from the root of this repo, branch backend-integration): (1) SMTP sink: python local-test/smtp_sink.py - fake mailbox on 127.0.0.1:1025 that appends every received email to sink_mail.log (this is where the 6-digit code lands); (2) API: cd api && mvn spring-boot:run (needs Java 21 + Maven) - listens on http://localhost:8080 and delivers the email to the sink; (3) front-end, only if you also want to click through it in a browser: cd front-end && python -m http.server 8000, then open http://localhost:8000. Once 1 and 2 are up, send the Folder-1 requests. The 502 test needs the sink stopped first (close its terminal). If you are on the same network as the machine running the API, you can also point the emailApi variable at that machine's LAN IP instead of localhost.

Folder 2 is CONTRACT ONLY: those endpoints do not exist yet (see BACKEND_TASKS.md - T1 verify endpoint, T4 validate-referral Edge Function). Requests there will 404 today.

variable.description: Supabase Edge Function base URL - set to https://<project>.supabase.co/functions/v1 once Siyabonga ships T4

item.name: Send verification code - expect 200
item.description:
Precondition: SMTP sink running on 127.0.0.1:1025 (local test mailbox, part of run-local-test.bat).

Expect 200 {"message":"Verification code sent."} and the 6-digit code appended to sink_mail.log.

item.name: Invalid email - expect 400
item.description: Server-side @Email validation (EmailCodeRequest) rejects it with a 400 Bad Request body.

item.name: Blank email - expect 400
item.description: Server-side @NotBlank validation rejects it with a 400 Bad Request body.

item.name: SMTP down - expect 502 (stop the sink FIRST)
item.description:
STOP the SMTP sink first (close its terminal / taskkill the python process), otherwise this returns 200.

Expect 502 with the RFC-7807 ProblemDetail body: {"detail":"The verification email could not be sent. Please try again later."}

item.name: 2. Not deployed yet - contract only (see BACKEND_TASKS.md)
Verify email code - T1 (Spring; 404 today)
item.description:
BACKEND TASK T1 - does not exist yet (today: Spring 404). Contract: send a code first with the 200 request, then verify it with the 6 digits from sink_mail.log.

Expected once built: 200 {"message":"Email verified."} / 400 generic "The code is incorrect or has expired." (10-min TTL, single-use, 5-attempt cap).
